name: us-tax-residency
description: Decide whether an individual is a US resident or nonresident for federal income tax in 2026, and from which date. Covers US citizens (always resident and taxed on worldwide income), the green card test, the substantial presence test under 26 U.S.C. 7701(b) (at least 31 days in 2026 and 183 weighted days counting all 2026 days, one-third of 2025 days and one-sixth of 2024 days), days that do not count, exempt individuals on F, J, M, Q, A and G visas and their year limits, the closer connection exception on Form 8840, the first-year choice, residency starting and termination dates with the 10-day rule, treaty tie-breakers on Form 8833, the spousal elections under section 6013(g) and (h), and dual-status returns.
